messages:
incident-bot: [ALERT] prod: sudden spike in 5xx (502/504) + gateway timeouts observed on inference-gateway -> affecting requests that hit prefix-kv cache. error rate up from 0.2% to 3.6% in the last 6m. Pager: @maria (oncall-eng-sre). See dashboard: https://redwood.testing/metrics/alerts/1738889999

maria: I'm on it. tagging eng-runtime (@sam) and eng-infra (@alex). can folks jump in?

sam: joining. quick snapshot: p99 latency for gateway = 1.8s, p50 = 190ms. 20% of failing requests include "kv-prefix:true" in trace. logs show repeated "checksum mismatch" and many proxied 502s from kv-shard-7.

alex: seeing eviction churn on prefix cache pods in us-west-2. eviction-rate spiked ~4x at 13:02 UTC. likely prefetch thrash + compaction race.

maria: customer impact? any high-traffic tenants?

sam: preliminary: error budget burn focused on customer cohort A (10 customers) in US-WEST. total request volume hit 1.2M reqs in 5m, errors ~43k. not global.

alex: mitigation proposal: 1) disable prefix prefetch for prod cluster (config flip) to stop aggressive eviction/prefetch loops, 2) scale kv-prefix-store replicas + bump cache memory on shard-7, 3) enable bypass fallback to cold reads for gateway on error ramp.

maria: agree. low-risk first: flip prefetch off. can we do that via config-admin? sam, alex, who has permissions?

sam: alex does. alex: I'll patch config now and roll to 3 nodes canary. command: ```
# via config-admin service
POST /v1/configs/prod/prefix_cache
{ "enable_prefetch": false }
```

alex: applying to canary set 'prefix-cache-canary' -> done. ops-bot: kicked rollout for config change.

ops-bot: rollout started -> config-admin returned 202. canary targets: prefix-cache-canary (3 pods). health checks running.

sam: monitoring logs for checksum errors and gateway 5xx.

ops-bot: canary health ok at 30s. starting progressive rollout to remaining prefix-cache pods.

maria: flipping bypass logic next if we still see errors. Alex, can you scale kv store concurrently?

alex: scaling kv-prefix-store: ```kubectl scale deploy kv-prefix-store -n prod --replicas=5``` -> applied. Also bumping mem limit on shard-7 podset.

sam: seeing immediate reduction in eviction rate on canary hosts. checksum mismatches still in older pods but not new ones. gateway 5xx dropped from 3.6% -> 0.9% over 4m.

maria: good. continue rollout, keep an eye on tail latencies. set alert when 5xx > 1% for 5m.

alex: rollout complete. ops-bot confirmed.

ops-bot: rollout completed for prefix-cache config change. all pods now running with enable_prefetch=false.

sam: after full rollout, errors down to 0.6%, tail latency back to baseline. still seeing a handful of corrupted entries in KV that need deeper investigation (likely compaction race). opened issue INC-4237 with logs + traces.

maria: customer impact summary for comms: ~0.7% of requests saw 502/504s, concentrated in US-WEST, window ~13:01-13:28 UTC. affected cohort: streaming inference customers using long-prefix routing. No data loss. recommending outreach to top 5 impacted customers. @product-notify can you draft notification?

product-notify: drafting now. will include mitigation steps and ETA for postmortem.

sam: next steps: 1) triage INC-4237 (sam owner) - reproduce locally with compaction fixture, 2) add stronger checksum validation + async repair path (alex owner), 3) add config guardrails to prevent prefetch oscillation (runtime).

maria: handing off primary on-call to @luis for the next 4 hours to monitor regression and customer comms. luis, can you ack?

luis: ack. will monitor and escalate if error >1% for 10m. copying runbook steps into thread: ```
1) check dashboard: https://redwood.testing/dash/kv-prefix
2) if eviction-rate spike -> disable prefetch (config-admin)
3) scale kv-prefix-store replicas
4) enable gateway bypass to cold reads: set route.fallback=enabled
5) gather logs: /var/logs/prefix-cache/*.log -> upload to S3
```

maria: thanks all. we'll do a full postmortem. initial impact assessment and mitigation notes saved to INC-4237. assigning owners: sam/runtime, alex/kv-infra, maria/oncall.

ops-bot: paging summary: incident resolved (mitigated) at 13:28 UTC, severity: Sev2. follow-up actions recorded in INC-4237.

maria: closing handoff. luis, please update this thread if anything flares.

luis: will do. leaving a short note once 2h window passes.

sam: FYI — I captured a minimal repro run that triggers corrupted index pages during forced compaction, will attach PR with test and tentative fix tomorrow.

alex: after postmortem we should add a canary for compaction and validate checksums post-compaction automatically.

maria: agreed. thanks everyone :thumbsup:
